_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in real values, or let /setup generate it. Any key you omit falls back to the safe default documented in ../PLAN.md.
_comment_action_types: V2 (M8): register extra dashboard action types (icon + label) without editing server.py. Built-ins: message_send, ticket_update, calendar_change.
_comment_live_refresh: V2 (M7): when true, the dashboard polls /graph-version and reloads when the approval queue or knowledge graph changes. Off by default (V1 behavior). live_refresh_seconds is the poll interval (min 5).
